answer: Cross-chain binding at the inlet: each identity must post a ZK proof tying one wallet across N chains to a single stake. The violet nullifier set enforces one-identity-one-vote by rejecting reused roots. A sybil farming k chains pays k× gas plus bridge fees; the marble of verified history accumulates only on the honest chain, so fake branches never finalize. Attacker cost scales linearly while influence stays flat. This works because cross-chain proofs make splitting identities costlier than honest participation.
